tagline: Plan synthetic perception data with measurable coverage.
introduction: A physical-AI data companion grounded in Scailab's public description of synthetic environments, perception and sim-to-real evaluation.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Scailab? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Design a scenario matrix
capabilities.description: Plan required weather and occlusion coverage; a source-only fictional helper distinguishes declared counts, unknowns and missing strata without measuring transfer.

capabilities.title: Plan sim-to-real validation
capabilities.description: Define evidence needed to compare synthetic and real observations.

capabilities.title: Review dataset assumptions
capabilities.description: Identify gaps, leakage and unsupported labels in supplied dataset metadata.

capabilities.title: Design Scailab challenge support
capabilities.description: Perception coverage auditor. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
inputs: a scoped public or synthetic task and the exact challenge or integration question
outputs: Held-out scene misses/unknowns and coverage gaps reported with labelled inputs
source references, dependencies and explicitly unverified actions
